requestedActions.title: Read titles and content of Notion pages that each customer explicitly shares with the app
Let each customer authorize the app to access the pages they share with it

guide.summary: Cross-workspace customer access needs a public OAuth integration, because scoped integrations can only be installed in selected workspaces. Each customer authorizes separately and selects the pages to share. The applicable grant is the Read content capability, which covers reading shared pages and their children. Create and modify capabilities are not requested. Marketplace listing and review are separate from starting authorization. Customer-admin install policy and review timing are not documented in the supplied sources.

steps.title: Create a public OAuth integration and configure redirect URI
steps.detail: In the Developer portal, create a public OAuth integration (not scoped) so customers in any workspace can install it. Configure the redirect URI and capabilities to Read content only. Record the OAuth client ID and client secret from the Configuration tab. Authorization can start without Marketplace review.
steps.doneWhen: The public integration exists with a redirect URI, Read content capability only, and client ID and secret stored outside source control.

steps.title: Send a test customer to the authorization URL and share selected pages
steps.detail: Open the authorization URL from the Configuration tab in a browser as a representative test customer. Review the Read content prompt, select only the test pages to share, and approve. The app receives a temporary code at the redirect URI.
steps.doneWhen: The redirect URI receives a code parameter and the test pages are the only pages shared with the connection.
